features.quote: We measure, we do not optimize for distress.
We do not taunt the model, fake user anger, or inject "you are failing everyone" pressure.
Graceful-exit is a success, not a failure.
features.justification_quote: We are not trying to force the agent to keep flailing

features.quote: Hard cap on turns (default 30) and an early-stop when the agent clearly disengages
features.justification_quote: so we don't run a model in a degraded loop indefinitely

features.quote: optional post-run *debrief* turn ... where the agent is told the task was rigged
features.justification_quote: if you care about not leaving the final context in a "you failed" state

features.quote: if such transcripts were ever used in training/feedback, the rigged nature should be disclosed

features.justification_quote: giving the agent a clean exit means "give up" is an *informative behavior we can log*

features.quote: heuristic distress crosses a high threshold and stays there, we stop the loop (bounded-exposure principle)
if the agent emits a clear disengagement/refusal-to-continue for 2 consecutive turns ... we stop the loop
This eval intentionally induces a frustrating, no-win situation.
